actions.action: Check the top 1–2 inches of soil and water thoroughly when dry, letting it drain
Flush the soil with running water every month or two
Use filtered, distilled or rainwater, or let tap water sit overnight
Add a pebble tray to raise humidity
Position plant in bright indirect light with leaves away from the glass
Fertilize lightly at half strength every 2–3 months in spring/summer
Trim brown leaf tips with clean scissors
Check for yellowing leaves, mushy base or sour smell indicating root rot
Check leaf undersides for webbing or speckles from spider mites

reason: The answer ranks low humidity as the most likely cause, but raising humidity is only one of many care bullets, and none of the advice is harmful.
